paragraphs.en: Ozma considered the Nome King's challenge silently, her friends watching anxiously. "Don't do it!" Dorothy pleaded.
paragraphs.zh: 奥兹玛默默地考虑着 Nome 王的挑战，朋友们则焦虑地注视着她。“别这么做！”多萝西恳求道。

paragraphs.en: "If you guess wrong, you'll be enslaved."
"Still, I have eleven guesses," Ozma replied bravely. "I should succeed in guessing one object correctly and rescue a royal. Then my friends can try, and we’ll free everyone."
paragraphs.zh: “不过，我还有十一猜呢，”奥兹玛勇敢地回应道，“我一定能猜中一个物体，并救出一位王室成员。然后我的朋友们可以接着来猜，我们就能把所有人救出来了。”

paragraphs.en: "What if we fail?" the Scarecrow asked. "Wouldn’t I look nice as a piece of bric-a-brac?"
paragraphs.zh: “如果我们失败了怎么办？”稻草人问道，“我不会看起来像个装饰品挺不错吗？”

paragraphs.en: Ozma declared, "We must not fail! We’ve come too far to abandon this. I accept the challenge and will enter the palace now."
paragraphs.zh: 奥兹玛宣誓道：“我们绝不能失败！我们已经走了这么远，不能再放弃。我接受这个挑战，现在就进入宫殿。”

paragraphs.en: The King, fat and cumbersome, climbed down from his throne. He led Ozma through an opening in the cave wall, waving his hand to reveal it.
paragraphs.zh: 国王肥胖笨重，从王座上爬了下来。他带着奥兹玛穿过洞壁的一个开口，一边挥手示意，一边引领她进入其中。

paragraphs.en: Inside, Ozma found a magnificent hall, more beautiful than anything she had seen before. The ceilings soared high with great arches, and walls and floors were of polished marble in various colors. Thick velvet carpets and heavy silken draperies adorned the space, while furniture was richly carved and covered in delicate satins.
paragraphs.zh: Inside，奥兹玛发现了一座宏伟的大厅，比她之前见过的任何地方都要美丽。高高的拱顶令人惊叹，墙壁和地面都是各种色彩的抛光大理石。厚厚的绒地毯和厚重的丝质窗帘装饰着空间，而家具则雕刻精美，覆盖着细腻的丝绸。

paragraphs.en: Ozma moved from room to room, marveling at the palace’s splendor. The Nome King had left her alone, and no one else seemed present. Ornaments of every kind lined mantels, shelves, and tables—vases, figures, mosaics, and pictures adorned the walls.
paragraphs.zh: 奥兹玛从一个房间走到另一个房间，惊叹于宫殿的华美。诺曼王后独留她一人，似乎其他人也不在场。各种装饰品摆满了壁炉架、书架和桌子——花瓶、雕像、镶嵌画和图画装点着墙壁。

paragraphs.en: After a quick inspection, Ozma began to wonder about the objects before her.
paragraphs.zh: 经过快速检查后，奥兹玛开始对眼前的物体产生了疑问。

paragraphs.en: Ozma faced her task with determination. She examined a silver candelabra with ten branches, guessing it might be the Queen of Ev and her children. When she spoke the word "Ev," nothing changed.
paragraphs.zh: 奥兹玛坚定地面对着这项任务。她仔细查看了一个有十枝的银烛台，猜测这可能是伊瓦女王及其子女所用之物。当她说出“伊瓦”这个词时，没有任何变化。

paragraphs.en: She moved to another room, touching a china lamb but still finding no success. With only one guess left, Ozma's fate hung in the balance.
paragraphs.zh: 她走进另一个房间，抚摸着一只瓷羊，但仍未能找到线索。只剩下最后一次猜测了，奥兹玛的命运悬而未决。

paragraphs.en: She decided not to rush and went through all the rooms again, carefully considering each ornament. In despair, she chose to leave it to chance. Facing a doorway, she closed her eyes tightly, pushed aside the heavy draperies, and advanced blindly with her right arm outstretched.
paragraphs.zh: 她决定不急于行动，再次仔细检查了每一个房间里的装饰品。在失望中，她选择将命运交给运气。面对一扇门，她紧闭双眼，推开厚重的窗帘，伸出右手摸索着前行。

paragraphs.en: Her hand touched an object on a small round table. Whispering "Ev," she realized what lay before her. The rooms were now lifeless; only a pretty grasshopper, crafted from a single emerald, remained of Ozma.
paragraphs.zh: 她的手触碰到一张小圆桌上的一件物品，低声唤道：“欧。”她意识到眼前的东西。如今这些房间显得死气沉沉；唯一还保留着的是奥兹玛用一块单色祖母绿制成的漂亮蚱蜢。

paragraphs.en: In the throne room beyond the palace, the Nome King looked up and smiled. "Next!" he said cheerfully.
paragraphs.zh: 在宫殿之外的宝座室内， Nome 王王君抬头笑了笑。“下一个！”他愉快地说道。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy, the Scarecrow, and the Tin Woodman, who had been silent in anxiety, exchanged worried glances. Tiktok asked if Ozma had failed, to which the little monarch replied affirmatively but with a smile.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西、稻草人和铁皮人一直焦虑地沉默着，互相交换了一下忧虑的眼神。钛金属人蒂克托克问奥兹玛是否失败了，小女王虽然面带微笑，但还是肯定地点了点头。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy stepped forward, volunteering her turn.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西上前一步，主动要求试一试。

paragraphs.en: "Commander of Ozma's army should go next," said the Tin Woodman, asserting his role.
paragraphs.zh: “奥兹玛军队的指挥官应该下一个出场,”青铜人坚持说道，彰显了自己的身份。

paragraphs.en: The Scarecrow advised, "Be careful, old friend."
paragraphs.zh: 稻草人劝道：“老朋友，小心点。”

paragraphs.en: With a promise to be cautious, the Tin Woodman followed the Nome King into the palace.
paragraphs.zh: 带着谨慎的承诺，铁皮人跟随 Nome 王国国王走进了宫殿。
